query:
SELECT p.id, p.name, p.dbSlug, p.totalPacks, p.packsRemaining, 
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM checklist_items ci WHERE ci.productId = p.id) as itemCount
FROM products p 
WHERE p.name LIKE '%50%' OR p.dbSlug LIKE '%50%';
